building.name: Westfield Center
building.completed_conflict: The assessor's roll gives 1908; this address is recorded as built 1991.

historical_record.description: The Office of the Assessor-Recorder photographed the property for tax assessment. Zukor's Department Store was at the address.
Emporium Department Store, designed by G. Albert Lansburgh.
The San Francisco Shopping Center, later the Westfield San Francisco Centre, designed by architect Piero Patri; his largest project.
The Emporium, credited to the architect Albert Pissis.
Interior design for a Nordstrom store by architect Igor Sazevich.
The heavily damaged Emporium department store was rebuilt in 1908 by architects Albert Pissis and Joseph Moore.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.note: San Francisco Centre by Whisler/Patri, opened in 1988 as a downtown shopping centre competing with the suburban malls, finished in polished granite and applied ornament. Expanded onto the adjacent historic Emporium building site in 2006 by Kohn Pedersen Fox.

unknowns: The Emporium is credited to Albert Pissis for 1896 and to G. Albert Lansburgh for 1908.
The statement credits the 1908 rebuilding to Albert Pissis and Joseph Moore; the page credits it to G. Albert Lansburgh.
